AestheFill

AestheFill is a collagen-stimulating dermal filler made from Poly-D,L-Lactic Acid (PDLLA) that boosts your skin's own collagen production for natural-looking volume restoration and wrinkle reduction, improving sagging skin and fine lines gradually, with results lasting up to two years.

Injection zones

Safe zones: eye trough, forehead, nasal dorsum, chin, neck.
